name: tasted
description: Portable taste distillation and engineering harness for Codex, Claude Code, and Hermes.

interface.shortDescription: Portable taste distillation for coding agents
interface.longDescription: TasteDistill provides a portable engineering profile and staged taste-distillation workflows for Codex, Claude Code, and Hermes. Use the short plugin name TasteD/tasted when invoking it. It keeps user and project experience under ~/.tastedistill, avoids overwriting host memory by default, and uses CodeGraph when the current host exposes compatible repository-intelligence tools.
